description: Department Of Local Government - Central Province - Drinking Water and Water Catchment Safety By Law, Of the Pathadumbara Pradeshiya Sabha, wilgamuma Pradeshiya sabha Kothmale P.S and Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale P.S
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a new regulatory framework - the Drinking Water Safety By-law for Pathadumbara Pradeshiya Sabha. It creates legal requirements, prohibitions, and licensing procedures for water source management and drinking water safety. The content focuses entirely on regulatory matters and legal provisions rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
